thread:
sam: Heads-up — we've been getting repeated pages from gpu.scheduler.P99 in us-west1. 3 pages since midnight. Anyone seen this pattern before?

maya: yup, saw it too. almost all of them coincide with nightly batch and are single-job spikes. noisy.

kevin: Is this the Prom alert gpu_scheduler_queue_latency_p99? What are the current thresholds and grouping keys?

sam: rule is `gpu_scheduler_queue_latency_p99 > 200` for 3m, grouped by job_id and cluster. Grouping by job_id is creating a page per job.

maya: that's the culprit. We should group by cluster + queue instead of job_id. For paging vs ticketing: I think short, single-job spikes should create tickets only, not pages.

jordan: Agreed. Proposed policy: ticket for 3m spike OR page only when sustained 15m OR when impacted_nodes > 2. That reduces noise but keeps real outages paged.

anika: Also want to tie paging to SLO impact. If error budget burn rate > 2x then page immediately. Otherwise ticket. We can compute burn rate as a recording rule in Prometheus.

kevin: Example recording rule snippet I prototyped:
```
- record: gpu:queue_latency_p99:ratio
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(gpu_scheduler_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster))
- record: budget:burn_rate
  expr: increase(slo_error_count[5m]) / increase(slo_allowed_errors[5m])
```
We can use `budget:burn_rate` in alert conditions.

sam: Nice. Also let's add a mute window for 00:00-04:00 PST for scheduled nightly batches (configurable per-cluster).

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging alert rule change pushed (PR #2745).

maya: I'll validate in staging. Can someone update PagerDuty escalation so only the new page condition triggers a page? Right now any alert -> page. @oncall

jordan: I'll update PD routing to only forward when `sustained=true` OR `budget_burn>2`. For other firings create a ticket via webhook. Also add an automatic 1h mute after manual ack to avoid re-paging on churn.

anika: Suggest we also vary thresholds by cluster size: small clusters -> higher p99 threshold (e.g., 400ms) to avoid false positives; large clusters keep 200ms. We can implement per-cluster labels or use metadata in recording rules.

kevin: Good idea. We should baseline thresholds against 30d histograms first. I'll add a Grafana panel that shows P99 over the last 30d and an alert history (noise rate). That will help tune thresholds without guessing.

sam: Proposed immediate action items: 1) change grouping to cluster+queue, 2) implement sustained/impacted_nodes page condition, 3) add SLO burn condition, 4) mute window 00-04 for nightly batch clusters, 5) update PD routing and add 1h post-ack mute, 6) add runbook link in alert message. I'll open a tracking ticket.

maya: Sounds good. One more tiny nit: ensure alerts include `runbook_url` and `playbook_steps` in annotations so oncall can triage from the notification quickly.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-1289: "Alert tuning: gpu.scheduler paging vs ticketing" and linked PR #2745 for staging.

kevin: I'll build the dashboard panel and add a panel showing "alerts fired per rule" + noise rate by cluster.

jordan: After we validate in staging for 24h, we'll roll to prod with gradual rollout (canary clusters).

sam: Thanks all — appreciate the quick sync. ping here when PR is merged so I can monitor the first few hours. :thumbsup:
